cards.claim: Muon-C reaches superior early-training FID on CIFAR-10 flow matching compared to unfolded Muon and Adam
cards.conditions: CIFAR-10, flow matching task, 40k iterations, matched applied-update RMS
cards.effect: 9.87 FID (Muon-C) vs 22.26 FID (unfolded Muon) vs 51.31 FID (Adam)
cards.evidence: Direct empirical measurement on standard benchmark
cards.quote: On CIFAR-10 flow matching with matched applied-update RMS, Muon-C reaches 9.87 FID at 40k iterations, compared with 22.26 for unfolded Muon and 51.31 for Adam.

cards.claim: Muon-C reaches baseline final quality using substantially fewer FLOPs than unfolded Muon and Adam
cards.conditions: CIFAR-10, flow matching, reaching 400k-step final quality target
cards.effect: 38% FLOP reduction vs unfolded Muon, 36% FLOP reduction vs Adam
cards.evidence: Computational efficiency comparison on standard benchmark
cards.quote: It reaches the baselines' 400k-step final quality using only and their model FLOPs, corresponding to savings of 38% and 36%.

cards.claim: Muon-C outperforms unfolded Muon and Adam under equal optimizer-specific tuning budgets on CIFAR-10
cards.conditions: CIFAR-10 flow matching, equal per-optimizer hyperparameter sweep budget
cards.effect: 3.42 FID (Muon-C) vs 3.54 FID (unfolded Muon) vs 3.83 FID (Adam)
cards.evidence: Controlled empirical comparison with matched tuning budgets
cards.quote: Under equal optimizer-specific sweep budgets, Muon-C obtains 3.42 FID on CIFAR-10, compared with 3.54 for unfolded Muon and 3.83 for Adam.

cards.claim: Muon-C maintains efficiency gains on larger CIFAR-scale data (ImageNet-1k-32)
cards.conditions: ImageNet-1k-32, flow matching, 40k iterations and final tuned quality
cards.effect: 21.14 and 12.02 FID (Muon-C) vs 28.02 and 13.24 FID (unfolded Muon) at 40k steps and final tuned FID respectively
cards.evidence: Cross-dataset validation showing generalization of gains
cards.quote: On ImageNet-1k-32, it improves both the 40k-step FID and the tuned final FID, reaching 21.14 and 12.02 compared with 28.02 and 13.24 for unfolded Muon.

cards.claim: Muon-C (operator-aligned variant of Muon) transfers to CNN classification across multiple architectures
cards.conditions: ImageNet-100 classification, ResNet-34, ResNet-50, and ConvNeXtV2-T architectures
cards.effect: Achieves highest validation accuracy across all tested architectures compared to baselines
cards.quote: On ImageNet-100, Muon-C attains the highest validation accuracy across ResNet-34, ResNet-50, and ConvNeXtV2-T despite their widely different exposure to the convolutional optimizer route.
